title: AI能否评估AI科学家？基于自动多模型评审的自主研究生成系统基准测试研究
summary: 提出利用前沿大语言模型进行自动同行评审的基准测试协议，评估四个AI科学家框架（Sakana AI v1/v2、CycleResearcher、Data-to-Paper）生成的论文质量。结果显示FARS基准论文显著优于其他系统，且Gemini和Claude评审一致性高，验证了多模型评估的可靠性。
summary_en: Proposes a benchmarking protocol using frontier LLMs for automated peer review, evaluating four AI Scientist frameworks. FARS benchmark papers significantly outperform others, with strong agreement between Gemini and Claude, validating multi-model evaluation reliability.
